name: testid-autoinject
description: Zero-touch build-time injection of stable testID / data-testid for React Native (Expo) and Next.js. Frontend writes nothing; QA automation (Appium, Playwright) gets stable selectors.

scripts.build:swc: npm run build:swc15 && npm run build:swc16
scripts.build:swc15: cd packages/swc-plugin && cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip1 && mkdir -p ../../dist/swc && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/testid_autoinject_swc.wasm ../../dist/swc/plugin-15.wasm
scripts.build:swc16: cd packages/swc-plugin-16 && cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip1 && mkdir -p ../../dist/swc && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/testid_autoinject_swc_16.wasm ../../dist/swc/plugin-16.wasm
scripts.test:swc: cd packages/swc-plugin && cargo test && cd ../swc-plugin-16 && cargo test
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build:swc
